# Readwise Reader

Save, list, organize, update, and delete documents in a Readwise Reader library.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/readwise-reader/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Update Documents**: Partially update up to 50 Reader documents in one request and return a success or error result for every document.
- **Delete Document**: Permanently delete one Reader document by its ID.
- **List Documents** (read-only): List, filter, incrementally sync, or fetch a specific Reader document.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List tags in the connected Reader library, returning one page and a cursor for the next page.
- **Save Document**: Save a URL or supplied HTML as a document in the connected Reader library, with optional metadata, location, and tags.
- **Update Document**: Partially update supported fields on one Reader document by ID.
